cards.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

question: Can I spend mana from The Enigma Jewel's activated ability to activate its own craft ability?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: craft abilities are activated abilities, so that mana can be spent on its own craft ability.
expected.answer: Craft abilities are activated abilities. You can spend mana from The Enigma Jewel's activated ability to activate its own craft ability, for example.
